chapter.heading: Psalm 117A Psalm of Praise.
chapter.v:
O praise
the Lord, all you nations! Praise Him, all you people! [Rom 15:11]

For His
lovingkindness prevails over us [and we triumph and overcome through Him], And the truth of the Lord endures forever.Praise the Lord! (Hallelujah!)
